role: The base class of every container screen: draws the container's background and slots, tracks the hovered slot and cursor stack, and turns mouse and keyboard input into PlayerControllerMP.windowClick calls (modes 0-6, including drag-splitting and double-click pickup-all).
scope_reason: Container screens are pixel-gated (out/java/render/gui_* scenes) and the click path changes real inventory state, so both halves are in scope.

notes: Mode coverage verified by reading container.c slot_click_inner branches: modes 0/1 (1522), 2 (1671), 3 creative (1741), 4 (1753), 5 drag (1433), 6 pickup-all (1766). Input: csrc/engine/gui_input.c ports mouseClicked, mouseClickMove, mouseMovedOrUp and keyTyped as GuiScreen.handleInput runs them inside the client tick (every Mouse event, then every Keyboard event, each click predicted before the next event), judged against Java's own GuiContainer over the same raw events by csrc/tests/gui_judge.sh (lane/clientui). Events after a close key in the same tick are dropped (Java keeps feeding them to the closed screen). lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records cat-toss-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour. lane/idxclient: the dead player's auto-close ported; func_146285_a's tooltip now carries getTooltip's lines (enchantments, records, potions and their When Applied block, Dyed, Sharpness in the attack damage): the idx-tip recordings at 0 px. The draw-time prune (func_146977_a's remove and func_146980_g) is gui_input_drawn, run where the client draws its screen (the live frame before live_screens, the judge's after each tick): guijudge/prune-s1 drags left over two empty slots and the emptied slot 9, a dev give lands dirt in slot 9 while the drag is held, and the release spreads over 18 and 19 alone as Java's rendered GuiContainer sent it (recorded with EVERY=1: the same raw events with no frames keep slot 9, since the prune runs only in drawScreen).
